levels.surface: عبد العزيز بن عبد الله العامري الأويسي

notes: «أخبرني عروة، أنه سأل عائشة» (rule 5): Urwa asks, but the saying is Aisha's answer, so she is the last link; Urwa is the source of Ibn Shihab
«وقال الليث» starts a second isnad with the same saying: a second group, not a variant (rule 4); both groups end at Aisha, so the tail is null
the matn's «قالت عائشة» are her own words, not extra links
